name: Suspicious Hoofprints
summary: Smoke rises from the Shady Rest Inn, and Suspicious Hoofprints cross the marsh. Some prints are clear; others fade in the soft mud. Captain Garran Vimes in Theramore needs the report.

sections.title: Prints in the Mud
sections.body: Hoofprints lead from the smoking ruin of the Shady Rest Inn into the marsh. Some are easy to see, while others nearly vanish in the soft mud. Captain Garran Vimes in Theramore needs to hear about them.

sections.title: What Vimes Makes of It
sections.body: Centaur activity is common near Dustwallow Marsh. Short trips into the Barrens have revealed their camps and holdings scattered across the area. Vimes will send Falgran Hastil, one of the trackers, to learn where the prints lead.

faq.answer: The prints lead from the still-smoking Shady Rest Inn and across the soft marsh mud.

faq.q: Who receives the report about the prints?
aliases: who do i tell about the hoofprints
faq.answer: Captain Garran Vimes in Theramore receives the report.

faq.q: How easy are the prints to follow?
aliases: are the prints hard to see
faq.answer: Some prints are clear, but many nearly vanish in the mud.
